response.sql: SELECT sites.entrystat, AVG(scanenvironment.ambictemp), AVG(scanenvironment.imgcount), AVG(scanenvironment.imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(imgcount) FROM scanenvironment) FROM scanenvironment JOIN sites ON scanenvironment.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry GROUP BY sites.entrystat

assumptions.assumption: The 'overall' average image count refers to the average across all scanenvironment records globally, not just those that match a site.

alternatives.interpretation: The 'overall' average image count should be calculated only from scanenvironment records that match a site, rather than from all scanenvironment records.
alternatives.sql: SELECT sites.entrystat, AVG(scanenvironment.ambictemp), AVG(scanenvironment.imgcount), AVG(scanenvironment.imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(se.imgcount) FROM scanenvironment se JOIN sites s ON se.zoneref = s.zoneregistry) FROM scanenvironment JOIN sites ON scanenvironment.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry GROUP BY sites.entrystat
